 Reeves congratulates Senator-elect Colom, who names transition team 
 Governor says he is ready to work with Colom for Mississippi 
 By WLBT Staff Published : Nov. 19, 2026 at 9:28 AM CST | Updated : 21 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google JACKSON, Miss. (WLBT) - Gov. Tate Reeves said he has congratulated Senator-elect Scott Colom and is ready to work with him for Mississippi.
 Reeves’ comments
 Reeves said Colom “worked incredibly hard, and so you know I give him credit for that, and the reality is the election is over.”
 “The election is behind us and all of us who have been elected over time need to work together to do what’s in the best interest of Mississippi and I’m confident that we’ll be able to do that,” Reeves said.
 Colom in Washington
 Colom is on Capitol Hill for freshman orientation. He shared photos from Washington with his wife, Nadia. He said he is grateful to have her by his side and excited to get to work.
 Transition team
 Colom has named a transition team to help him prepare for office.
 Mississippi NAACP Executive Director Charles Taylor and Diane Feldman, a longtime political mentor, will lead the team. It also includes former Mississippi congressman Chip Pickering.
 “Mississippians built this campaign, and I am honored Mississippians will guide this team as we get to work for the people of Mississippi,” Colom said.
